title: Hanuma advises Angada
introduction: Hanuma advises Angada to not to desert the mainstream kingdom to establish a separate one, which will definitely attract the fury of Sugreeva. Hanuma uses political tactics in pacifying Angada, who is utterly terrorised of Sugreeva in the event of the failure of the task under his leadership.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे चतुः पंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 54th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तथा ब्रुवति तारे तु तारा अधिपति वर्चसि |
अथ मेने हृतम् राज्यम् हनुमान् अंगदेन तत्
verses.iast:
tathā bruvati tāre tu tārā adhipati var.hcasi |
atha mene hṛtam rājyam hanumān aṃgadena tat
verses.translation: When Lt Tara whose resplendence is similar to moonshine has spoken that way, then Hanuma deemed that Angada is laying siege to that kingdom of Vanaras. [4541]

glosses.meaning: by Lt. Tara, that way, has spoken
by Angada that, kingdom, stolen [laying siege to]

verses.devanagari:
बुद्ध्या हि अष्ट अंगया युक्तम् चतुर् बल समन्वितम् |
चतुर् दश गुणम् मेने हनुमान् वालिनः सुतम्
verses.iast:
buddhyā hi aṣṭa aṃgayā yuktam catur bala samanvitam |
catur daśa guṇam mene hanumān vālinaḥ sutam
verses.translation: Hanuma considered Vali's son Angada indeed as having eightfold intelligence, fourfold tactics, fourteen traits. [4542]
notes: The IQ of an average person is eightfold as said: -śuśrūṣa śavaṇam caiva grahaṇam dhāraṇam tathā | ūha apoha artha vijñānam tattva jñānam ca dhī guṇāḥ

śuśrūṣa assiduously polite - 1] attentiveness; śravaṇam ardently listening - 2] heedfulness; grahanam instantly grasping - 3] receptiveness; dhāraṇam continually remembering - 4] retentiveness; ūha discrimination of pros and cons - 5] speculativeness; apoha indecisiveness about the undesirables and receiving the worthwhile - 6] fastidiousness; artha vijñānam substance's, comprehensive knowledge - 7] omniscience; tattva jñānam quintessence's, profundity - 8] acumen.

The fourfold tactics or abilities are sāma, dāna, bheda, danḍa 1] placation, 2] presentation, 3] partition, 4] persecution. The other way these four are four abilities mano bala, bāhu bala, upāya bala, bandhu bala self-assuring strengths of self-opinion, self-shoulder strtength, self-ideation and self-consistent supporters.

deśa kālajñata dārḍhyam sarva kleśa sahiṣṇutā | sarva vijñānitā dākṣyam ūrjaḥ samvṛta mantratā | avisamviditā śauryam śaktijñatvam kṛtajñatā | śaraṇa āgata vatslyam amarṣatvam acālana | 1] knowledge of place and time, 2] sturdiness, 3] enduring troubles, 4] knowing all possible, 5] skilfulness, 6] self-defence, 7] maintaining confidentiality of strategies, 8] avoiding unwanted debates [or, not uttering lies, 9] courageousness, 10] recognising strengths and weaknesses of one's own and of others also, 11] faithfulness, 12] sheltering the seekers of shelter, 13] showing anger at appropriate times, 14] unwavering in opinions or actions.

glosses.meaning: with eight, parts [eightfold,] intelligence, having, indeed

verses.devanagari:
आपूर्यमाणम् शश्वत् च तेजो बल पराक्रमैः |
शशिनम् शुक्ल पक्ष आदौ वर्धमानम् इव श्रिया
बृहस्पति समम् बुद्ध्या विक्रमे सदृशम् पितुः |
शुश्रूषमाणम् तारस्य शुक्रस्य इव पुरंदरम्
भर्तुः अर्थे परिश्रान्तम् सर्व शास्त्र विशारदः |
अभिसंधातुम् आरेभे हनुमान् अंगदम् ततः
verses.iast:
āpūryamāṇam śaśvat ca tejo bala parākramaiḥ |
śaśinam śukla pakṣa ādau vardhamānam iva śriyā
bṛhaspati samam buddhyā vikrame sadṛśam pituḥ |
śuśrūṣamāṇam tārasya śukrasya iva puraṃdaram
bhartuḥ arthe pariśrāntam sarva śāstra viśāradaḥ |
abhisaṃdhātum ārebhe hanumān aṃgadam tataḥ
verses.translation: Angada who is steadily brimming over with his spiritedness, mightiness, valorousness, and waxing like the moon starting from day one of White Fortnight of a month, who is comparable to Brihaspati, the Jupiter, in sagacity, who mirrors up his father Vali in intrepidity, but who is now assiduously attentive to the rebellious teachings of Lt. Tara, like Indra who once listened to the unlistenable teachings of demon's mentor, namely Shukraacaarya, as that Angada is overly enervated to fulfil the concerns of the king Sugreeva. Then Hanuma who is the scholar in all scriptures started to confederate the confidence of Angada with the present regime of Sugreeva. [4543, 4, 5]
notes: Indian categorisation of a month does not directly jump to weeks, but firstly into two fortnights, later into weeks and then to days: 1] paurṇami, poorṇimaWhite Fortnight - where the moon will be waxing from new-moon-day; 2] amāvāsyaBlack Fortnight - where the moon will be waning to no-moon-day.

glosses.meaning: Brihaspati [Jupiter,] one who is comparable to
in intrepidity, father, who mirrors up
in husbander's [king's, Sugreeva's] in concern, overly enervated [Angada]
in all, scripture, knowers, best one i.e., to Angada]

verses.devanagari:
स चतुर्णाम् उपायानाम् तृतीयम् उपवर्णयन् |
भेदयामास तान् सर्वान् वानरान् वाक्य संपदा
verses.iast:
sa caturṇām upāyānām tṛtīyam upavarṇayan |
bhedayāmāsa tān sarvān vānarān vākya sampadā
verses.translation: Hanuma then rhetorically started to the schismatic secession of all those vanaras, who are desirous of avoiding Sugreeva and desiring a hideout, exemplifying the third ideation, namely the partition, among the four political ideations, viz., placation, presentation, partition, persecution. [4546]
notes: The four ideations aresāma, dāna, bheda, daṇḍa upāyāḥThe ideations for placation, presentation, partition, persecution, in connection with a political adversary.

verses.devanagari:
तेषु सर्वेषु भिन्नेषु ततो अभीषय अंगदम् |
भीषणैः विविधैः वाक्यैः कोप उपाय समन्वितैः
verses.iast:
teṣu sarveṣu bhinneṣu tato abhīṣaya aṃgadam |
bhīṣaṇaiḥ vividhaiḥ vākyaiḥ kopa upāya samanvitaiḥ
verses.translation: When Hanuma made all of the vanaras to defect from Angada's idea of defecting Sugreeva, then Hanuma further overawed Angada with diverse and awesome orations containing the fourth ideation, namely the persecutory measures, employable by Sugreeva on defectors. [4547]

glosses.meaning: in them, in all, in defection [from Angada's idea of defecting from Sugreeva]

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् समर्थ तरः पित्रा युद्धे तारेय वै ध्रुवम् |
दृढम् धारयितुम् शक्तः कपि राज्यम् यथा पिता
verses.iast:
tvam samartha taraḥ pitrā yuddhe tāreya vai dhruvam |
dṛḍham dhārayitum śaktaḥ kapi rājyam yathā pitā
verses.translation: "As with your father you are undeniably abler in warfare, oh, the son of Lady Tara, and as with your father you are unquestionably capable enough to sustain the monkey kingdom." Thus Hanuma started to address Angada. [4548]

glosses.meaning: with your father, able, more [abler than]
monkey, kingdom, unquestionably, to sustain, capable.

verses.devanagari:
नित्यम् अस्थिर चित्ता हि कपयो हरि पुंगव |
न आज्ञाप्यम् विषहिष्यन्ति पुत्र दारान् विना त्वया
verses.iast:
nityam asthira cittā hi kapayo hari puṃgava |
na ājñāpyam viṣahiṣyanti putra dārān vinā tvayā
verses.translation: "Oh, best monkey, Angada, monkeys will be inconsistent at their will, isn't it! Separated from their sons and wives they cannot tolerate to remain under your control for a long. [4549]

glosses.itrans: kapayaH nityam a sthira cittaa hi
glosses.iast: kapayaḥ nityam a sthira cittā hi
glosses.devanagari: कपयः नित्यं अ स्थिर चित्ता हि
glosses.meaning: monkeys, always, not, consistent, at will, isn't it
sons, wives, without separated from them
to be ordered to remain under your control
not, verily, tolerate they will not abide.

verses.devanagari:
त्वाम् न एते हि अनुयुंजेयुः प्रत्यक्षम् प्रवदामि ते |
यथा अयम् जांबवान् नीलः सुहोत्रः च महाकपिः
न हि अहम् ते इमे सर्वे साम दान आदिभिः गुणैः |
दण्डेन न त्वया शक्याः सुग्रीवात् अपकर्षितुम्
verses.iast:
tvām na ete hi anuyuṃjeyuḥ pratyakṣam pravadāmi te |
yathā ayam jāmbavān nīlaḥ suhotraḥ ca mahākapiḥ
na hi aham te ime sarve sāma dāna ādibhiḥ guṇaiḥ |
daṇḍena na tvayā śakyāḥ sugrīvāt apakarṣitum
verses.translation: "I plainly tell you what is obvious. This Jambavanta, these monkeys like Niila, and great monkey Suhotra and others do not definitely tagalong you, isn't it. Likewise I too do not definitely tagalong you. Such as we are, it will be impossible for you to sidetrack us from Sugreeva using tactics like placation, presentation or even persecution, isn't so! [45410, 11]

glosses.meaning: obviously, to you, as how, I am telling I am plainly telling what is obvious
not, at heel, join, isn't it they won't tagalong you
those, these such as they are they, or, we are
placation, presentation, and the like, by tactics

verses.devanagari:
विगृह्य आसनम् अपि आहुः दुर्बलेन बलीयसा |
आत्म रक्षा करः तस्मात् न विगृह्णीत दुर्बलः
verses.iast:
vigṛhya āsanam api āhuḥ dur.hbalena balīyasā |
ātma rakṣā karaḥ tasmāt na vigṛhṇīta durbalaḥ
verses.translation: "Even if a mightless is at odds with the mighty he can linger on, so to speak, therefore guard yourself, for no mediocrity will be at odds... [45412]
notes: Vividly: 'though moralists say that the mighty shall not fall afoul of the mightless, but their relations will always be in estrangement... and the foulness of mightless with the mighty will run the relations afoul... thus, purchasing the wrath of the mighty by the mightless is futile... and such as you are, you seek asylum in such a cavity as counselled haphazardly by all these fickly monkeys... thus, beware that the mightless is the one who shall strive for selfguarding against the mighty, but not contrariwise...

glosses.meaning: to linger on, even if, [so to] speak
less mighty [mediocre mighty, mediocrities] not, will be at odds.

verses.devanagari:
याम् च इमाम् मन्यसे धात्रीम् एतत् बिलम् इति श्रुतम् |
एतत् लक्ष्मण बाणानाम् ईषत् कार्यम् विदारणे
verses.iast:
yām ca imām manyase dhātrīm etat bilam iti śrutam |
etat lakṣmaṇa bāṇānām īṣat kāryam vidāraṇe
verses.translation: "This matter of going underground into that Black Hole which you suppose as a hideout from Sugreeva, as you heard from Lt. Tara and others, but it is a deed of trifle to Lakshmana's arrows, not necessarily for Rama's arrows, in splitting apart whole of that Black Hole in a trice. [45413]

glosses.meaning: of which, this one, of earth [going underground]
this one, cavity [Black Hole,] thus, heard [by you from Lt. Tara]
all this [Black Hole] by far, to split apart

verses.devanagari:
स्वल्पम् हि कृतम् इन्द्रेण क्षिपता हि अशनिम् पुरा |
लक्ष्मणो निशितैः बाणैः भिन्द्यात् पत्र पुटम् यथा
verses.iast:
svalpam hi kṛtam indreṇa kṣipatā hi aśanim purā |
lakṣmaṇo niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ bhindyāt patra puṭam yathā
verses.translation: "Indeed, once Indra thudded his Thunderbolt on this very underground illusory place, but that act was indeed a trivial deed for that Thunderbolt made a single demonsized aperture to eliminate a single demon, Maya, which we now call Riksha bila, Black Hole, nevertheless Lakshmana will splinter whole of this Black Hole with his acute arrows, as if it is leafy bowl. [45414]

glosses.meaning: leafy, bowl, as if [it is a]

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणस्य च नाराचा बहवः सन्ति तत् विधाः |
वज्र अशनि सम स्पर्शा गिरीणाम् अपि दारकाः
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇasya ca nārācā bahavaḥ santi tat vidhāḥ |
vajra aśani sama sparśā girīṇām api dārakāḥ
verses.translation: "There are numerous ironarrows with Lakshmana that are kindred to Thunderbolt of Indra, whose punch will be equalling that of Thunderbolt and Lightning Flashes, and which are the splitters of mountains. [45415]
notes: Annex: 'of which you all may have heard, but a few of us like Jaambavanta, Nala, Neea, Lt. Tara and myself bear witness, personally... on piercing the seven sturdy trees Rama's arrow penetrated into the nethermost terrain of earth and resurfaced... then, Lakshmana's arrow can pulverise mountains, isn't so...'

glosses.meaning: Thunderbolt, Lightning Flash, equal, in touch [punch]

verses.devanagari:
अवस्थाने यदा एव त्वम् आसिष्यसि परंतप |
तदा एव हरयः सर्वे त्यक्ष्यन्ति कृत निश्चयाः
verses.iast:
avasthāne yadā eva tvam āsiṣyasi paraṃtapa |
tadā eva harayaḥ sarve tyakṣyanti kṛta niścayāḥ
verses.translation: "As and when you settle down in that underground, more so, an unbefitting place for a crown prince, oh, enemyburner Angada, then and there all the monkeys will desert you resolvedly. [45416]

glosses.meaning: down, place [underground, or, an unworthy place for a crown prince]

verses.devanagari:
स्मरंतः पुत्र दाराणाम् नित्य उद्विग्ना बुभुक्षिताः |
खेदिता दुःख शय्याभिः त्वाम् करिष्यन्ति पृष्ठतः
verses.iast:
smaraṃtaḥ putra dārāṇām nitya udvignā bubhukṣitāḥ |
kheditā duḥkha śayyābhiḥ tvām kariṣyanti pṛṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: "Always sulking and reminiscing on their sons and wives, and hungered for the proximity of their kinfolk and hungered for diverse palatability as any monkey would cherish, even so, lamenting on the beds of lament they push you backwards. [45417]

glosses.meaning: you, backwards, they render they push you back.

verses.devanagari:
स त्वम् हीनः सुहृद्भिः च हित कामैः च बंधुभिः |
तृणात् अपि भृश उद्विग्नः स्पंदमानात् भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
sa tvam hīnaḥ suhṛdbhiḥ ca hita kāmaiḥ ca baṃdhubhiḥ |
tṛṇāt api bhṛśa udvignaḥ spaṃdamānāt bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "Devoid of goodhearted friends and wellwishing relatives, you will become highly sullen in solitariness. Such as you are you will end up as a highly frightened monkey, even from the shaking of a piece of straw.
notes: He will become 'a crown prince of straw...'anena parijanaiḥ pari tyaktaḥ tṛṇāt api laghu taro bhavati iti sūcitam - dk if he discards his own people.

glosses.meaning: he, you such as you are

verses.devanagari:
अति उग्र वेगा निशिता घोरा लक्ष्मण सायकाः |
अपवृत्तम् जिघांसन्तो महावेगा दुरासदाः
verses.iast:
ati ugra vegā niśitā ghorā lakṣmaṇa sāyakāḥ |
apavṛttam jighāṃsanto mahāvegā durāsadāḥ
verses.translation: "By far, those fiercely frantic arrows of Lakshmana if targeted to kill you, in case you become a sidestepper from loyalties, will be terrifyingly twingeing. Further, those fierily frenetic arrows are irreversible. [45419]

glosses.meaning: intended to kill if targeted to kill you
highly, speedy [fierily frenetic arrows,] unassailable [here, irreversible.]

verses.devanagari:
अस्माभिः तु गतम् सार्धम् विनीतवत् उपस्थितम् |
आनुपूर्व्यात् तु सुग्रीवो राज्ये त्वाम् स्थापयिष्यति
verses.iast:
asmābhiḥ tu gatam sārdham vinītavat upasthitam |
ānupūrvyāt tu sugrīvo rājye tvām sthāpayiṣyati
verses.translation: "But, if you return to Kishkindha along with us, and if you obediently become Sugreeva's flanker, he establishes you only in kingdom as before. [45420]

glosses.meaning: us, along with, resolute [resolutely,] if gone [if returning to Kishkindha]
nearby, staying [staying at his side, flanker]

verses.devanagari:
धर्म राजः पितृव्यः ते प्रीति कामो दृढ व्रतः |
शुचिः सत्य प्रतिज्ञः च स त्वाम् जातु न नाशयेत्
verses.iast:
dharma rājaḥ pitṛvyaḥ te prīti kāmo dṛḍha vrataḥ |
śuciḥ satya pratijñaḥ ca sa tvām jātu na nāśayet
verses.translation: "Your paternaluncle Sugreeva's gleam is his honesty as he is free of dishonesty, his desire is affection as he is free of aversion, his dedication is staunch as he is free of prevarication, and he himself is exoneration as he is free from exploitation, thus in no way he liquidates you. [45421]

glosses.meaning: with probity, he gleams he gleams with probity

verses.devanagari:
प्रिय कामः च ते मातुः तत् अर्थम् च अस्य जीवितम् |
तस्य अपत्यम् च न अस्ति अन्यत् तस्मात् अंगद गम्यताम्
verses.iast:
priya kāmaḥ ca te mātuḥ tat artham ca asya jīvitam |
tasya apatyam ca na asti anyat tasmāt aṃgada gamyatām
verses.translation: "He is your mother's wellwisher, the strife of Sugreeva's life is for her only, more so, there is no other posterity to him than you. Oh, Angada, therefore go back to Kishkindha, rather than deflecting, deviating and deserting your own kingdom. [45422]
notes: By these words of advise Hanuma is said to have used all the four tactics of saama, daana, bheda, daNDa upaayaaH 'political ideations of 1] placation, 2] presentation, 3] partition, 4] persecution. This is how that is explained: atra tvam samartha taraḥ pitrā 4548 iti anena sāma uktam | nityam asthira cittā 4549 iti anena bheda uktaḥ | tvām jātu na nāśayet 45421 anena daṇda uktaḥ | asmābhiḥ tu gatam sārdham anena dānam uktam | evam bhedo api hanumatā sāma dāna danṇḍa pūrvaka eva kṛtaḥ | tena bhedanā angado api bivhīṣitaḥ | dk As these references are already there, they are not reiterated here.

glosses.meaning: his [Sugreeva's, strife of] life, for that, reason [for the sake of Lady Tara]

glosses.itrans: tasya anyat apatyam ca na asti
glosses.iast: tasya anyat apatyam ca na asti
glosses.devanagari: तस्य अन्यत् अपत्यं च न अस्ति
glosses.meaning: to him [to Sugreeva,] other, posterity, also, not, is there
